response.justification: Bogdan possesses a rare combination of hands-on experience with AI-agent infrastructure (MCP, agentic workflows) and high-throughput distributed systems (handling millions of requests per second at Dunnhumby). Although he lacks the specified Python requirement, his extensive polyglot background, proven technical leadership at the Staff level, and strong engineering craftsmanship make him a highly compelling candidate for this AI-native environment.
strengths: Direct experience building AI-agent infrastructure and MCP code generators.
Proven expertise in high-throughput architectures, having built microservices handling millions of HTTP requests per second.
Strong TypeScript proficiency combined with a demonstrated ownership mindset as a founder and Staff Engineer.
concerns: No mention of Python experience, which is listed as a strong must-have for the role.
Lacks explicit mention of managing on-call rotations or incident response operations.
Does not explicitly highlight stakeholder management or cross-functional coordination experience.
